description: An individual Task in the Tenant's Task Management System

additional_related_entities.description: An array of possible related entities for this Task.

assigned_to.description: Identifier of the user to which this task is assigned.

bucket_id.description: Required. The Id of the Bucket that currently contains this Task. Note: A bucket with this Id doesn't have to exist yet.

bucket_name.description: Read-Only. This property is only returned if a Bucket is registered with this name in the Task Management for this Tenant. If the `bucket_id` for this task is not registered as a Bucket in Task Management, this property will not be returned.

causation_id.description: An ID (preferably a uuid) that is used to define the artifact that is responsible for the creation of this Task.

chosen_outcome.description: The chosen outcome for this Task. This must be one of the possible outcomes in this Task's `possible_outcomes` list.

comment.description: An optional comment for this Task.

completed_date_time.description: Date and time at which the task's `percent_complete` was set to `100`. Use ISO 8601 format and in UTC time.

correlation_id.description: An optional ID (preferably a uuid) that is used to correlate this Task with other Tasks. This can be used to find (cor)related Tasks.

created_at.description: Read-Only. Date and time at which the task was created. Use ISO 8601 format and in UTC time.

created_by.description: Read-Only. The name or identifier for the user that is responsible for the creation of this Task.

description.description: A textual description of the task, supports Markdown syntax.

calculated_due_date_time.description: Date and time at which the task is due based on the offset (number of days and offset type) and `start_date_time`.

number_of_days.description: Number of days when the task is due based on `start_date_time`.

offset_type.description: Type of date offset when calculating `calculated_due_date_time`. Use `BUSINESS_DAYS` when you want to consider only business (working) days.

due_date_time.description: Date and time at which the task is due. Use ISO 8601 format and in UTC time.

icon.description: The identifying name of a Visma Icon to be used with the Task.

is_read_only.description: Read-Only. Indicates if this Task is read-only or not. Read-only tasks can be cancelled or deleted, but not altered by users. The status of a read-only task can be altered by client-systems (for instance a process). A task can be created as a read-only task by setting the `create_as_read_only` parameter to `true` in the `addTask` operation.

minimum_reviewers.description: Minimum number of reviewers required to complete the task. When set to `0`, the task is considered completed when `percent_complete` is set to `100`. If a `minimum_reviewers` is provided, Task Management will check if the number of reviewers is equal or higher than the `minimum_reviewers` when `percent_complete` is set to `100`. If this is not the case, the Task will not be considered completed and a `400` error will be returned when trying to update/store the task with a `percent_complete` of `100`.

origin.description: The name of the Process, Service or System that is responsible for the creation of this Task.

overdue.description: Read-Only. Indicates `true` if the `due_date_time` or `calculated_due_date_time` has expired before `percent_complete` was set to `100`. Indicates `false` if the `due_date_time` or `calculated_due_date_time` has not expired yet or if `percent_complete` was set to `100` before the `due_date_time` or `calculated_due_date_time` expired.

percent_complete.description: Percentage of task completion. When set to `100`, the task is considered completed.

possible_outcomes.description: An array of possible outcomes for this Task. Each outcome should be a string without any newlines.

priority.description: A priority for this Task. The higher the number, the higher the considered priority.

process_id.description: The Id of the Process that is responsible for the creation of this Task.

process_type.description: The name of the Process Type for this Process.

reference_id.description: An optional external reference Id for this Task.

related_entity.description: The URI of the Entity that is related or contextual to this Task. This property can be filled to reference a resource or Entity to which this task applies.

related_entity_type.description: The type of entity for which this task is created.

require_chosen_outcome.description: Indicates if a `chosen_outcome` is required for completing this Task. If this is set to `true` and no `chosen_outcome` is provided when `percent_complete` is set to `100`, a `400` error will be returned when trying to update/store the task.

reviewers.description: IDs of users who have reviewed the task.

start_date_time.description: Date and time at which the task starts. Use ISO 8601 format and in UTC time. If `start_date_time` is not provided then it is set with same value as in `created_at` property. It is used for calculation of `calculated_due_date_time` when `due_date_offset` is used.

status.description: Read-Only. Indicates whether the task is `ACTIVE` or `CANCELLED`.

task_id.description: Read-Only. A unique Identifier for this Task.

updated_at.description: Read-Only. Date and time at which the task was updated. Use ISO 8601 format and in UTC time.
